interview.answer: An element with display: grid or inline-grid, which establishes a grid formatting context for its children.
A direct child of a grid container, placed into the defined tracks.

interview.q: How do you define responsive columns in grid?
interview.answer: Use grid-template-columns with fr units and repeat with auto-fit or auto-fill.
It defines the number and size of rows in the explicit grid.
A flexible length that distributes free space in the grid proportionally among tracks.
It creates three equal-width columns that share the available space.
It adds space between rows and columns without adding margins to the outer edges.
A shorthand for grid-column-start and grid-column-end, placing an item across columns.
A shorthand for grid-row-start and grid-row-end, placing an item across rows.
It places an item by naming a grid area or by specifying row and column lines.
The dividing line between tracks, numbered from 1 and used for placement.
A single row or column in the grid, sized by the template.
The intersection of a single row and column track.
A rectangular region made of one or more cells, named in grid-template-areas.
It creates as many tracks as fit in the container and collapses empty ones.
It creates as many tracks as fit in the container but keeps empty ones.

interview.q: When would you choose auto-fill over auto-fit in a responsive grid?
interview.answer: Use auto-fill when you want to reserve track space for items that may be added later; use auto-fit when existing items should stretch to fill the row.
It sets a minimum and maximum size for a track, such as minmax(200px, 1fr).
It repeats a track pattern, such as repeat(3, 1fr) for three equal columns.
The algorithm that places items without explicit coordinates, filling the grid in order.

interview.q: How does grid-auto-flow affect item placement?
interview.answer: It sets whether auto-placed items fill rows or columns first.
grid-auto-flow: dense fills holes in the grid, which can reorder items visually.
Tracks created automatically when items are placed outside the explicit grid.
It sets the size of implicitly created rows.
It sets the size of implicitly created columns.
It lets a nested grid inherit its parent's track sizes for alignment across levels.
It names regions of the grid using ASCII-like rows of identifiers.

interview.q: How do you create a named grid area?
interview.answer: Define it in grid-template-areas and assign an item with grid-area: name.

interview.q: What is the difference between grid and flexbox?
interview.answer: Grid is two-dimensional; flexbox is one-dimensional, though you can nest them.

interview.q: When should you use grid over flexbox?
interview.answer: When you need to control both rows and columns, such as page layouts and card grids.
It aligns grid items along the inline axis within their cell.
It aligns grid items along the block axis within their cell.
It aligns the whole grid along the inline axis when it is smaller than the container.
It aligns the whole grid along the block axis when it is smaller than the container.
It overrides justify-items for a single grid item.
It overrides align-items for a single grid item.

interview.q: What does span do in placement?
interview.answer: It makes an item span multiple tracks, such as grid-column: span 2.

interview.q: What is the difference between 1 / 3 and span 2?
interview.answer: 1 / 3 places from line 1 to line 3; span 2 starts at the auto position and spans two tracks.

interview.q: What is the order property in grid?
interview.answer: It changes the visual order of grid items without changing DOM order.

interview.q: What is grid's effect on source order for accessibility?
interview.answer: Visual reordering does not change tab or screen-reader order, so keep DOM order meaningful.
A track sized to the smallest size its content can take without overflow.
A track sized to the largest size its content needs without wrapping.
It clamps a track size between min-content and a given maximum.

interview.q: What is the difference between fixed and flexible tracks?
interview.answer: Fixed tracks have a set size; flexible tracks using fr share free space.

interview.q: How do you centre a grid item in its cell?
interview.answer: Set justify-self: center and align-self: center, or use place-self: center.
